newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis down, soybeans steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis down, soybeans steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers dropped Friday in reaction to improved barge movement, grain dealers said.
Milder weather in the Midwest has broken up ice blockages on rivers, allowing an increase in barge traffic. Barge movement was slow, but dealers said it had improved.
"Things are definitely looking better," said one dealer.
Soybean basis values were unchanged Friday. Soybean values dropped sharply Thursday because of the increased barge movement.
Winter wheat values were mostly unchanged.
